 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Detect the hollow rectangular frame, then fill its interior with
    # alternating concentric square/rectangular rings (2, 5), leaving a
    # central 3x3 opening when possible.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 5 in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
    depth = 0
    while r0 + 1 + depth <= r1 - 1 - depth and c0 + 1 + depth <= c1 - 1 - depth:
        top, bot = r0 + 1 + depth, r1 - 1 - depth
        left, right = c0 + 1 + depth, c1 - 1 - depth
        if top > bot or left > right or (bot - top + 1 <= 3 and right - left + 1 <= 3):
            break
        color = 2 if depth % 2 == 0 else 5
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = color
            out[bot][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bot + 1):
            out[r][left] = color
            out[r][right] = color
        depth += 1
    return out
"
}
